configs/dsh-inspector-origin.run: d=$(mktemp -d) && npm_config_cache="$d/npm-cache" npm_config_logs_dir="$d/npm-logs" python3 bin/pack-local-bundle.py configs/dsh-inspector-origin "$d/p.tgz" >/dev/null; c=$?; rm -rf "$d"; exit $c

configs/upgrade-rc1.run: grep -q '^- id: fs-observation-policy$' preserve-observation.patch.yml && grep -q '^  disabled: false$' preserve-observation.patch.yml && grep -A2 '^    - id: fs-observation-policy$' "$DSH_UPSTREAM_ROOT/packages/bundle/base/cordis.patch.yml" | grep -q '^      disabled: true$'

plugins/dsh-session-cleanup.run: d=$(mktemp -d) && npm_config_cache="$d/npm-cache" npm_config_logs_dir="$d/npm-logs" python3 bin/pack-local-bundle.py plugins/dsh-session-cleanup "$d/p.tgz" >/dev/null; c=$?; rm -rf "$d"; [ $c -eq 0 ] && "$DSH_TEST_TARGET/node_modules/.bin/vitest" run --config "$(pwd)/tests/upgrade.config.mjs" tests/upgrade/local-session-cleanup.spec.ts

plugins/dsh-web-search-exa-compat.run: d=$(mktemp -d) && cp -r plugins/dsh-web-search-exa-compat "$d/" && node bin/build-target-consumers.mjs "$DSH_TEST_TARGET" "$d/dsh-web-search-exa-compat" >/dev/null; c=$?; rm -rf "$d"; [ $c -eq 0 ] && "$DSH_TEST_TARGET/node_modules/.bin/vitest" run --config "$(pwd)/tests/upgrade.config.mjs" plugins/dsh-web-search-exa-compat
